drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: We have revised the production and privilege-log provisions to commit to service within 14 days after service of the requests, specifically identify any claimed logging exceptions, and confirm that supplementation does not extend applicable deadlines. The draft also requires request-by-request objections and withholding statements; those individualized responses remain to be completed before service.

edits.text: 1. REQUEST-SPECIFIC RESPONSES AND OBJECTIONS. Defendant will state separately for each request whether production will be permitted and identify each objection, including its specific grounds and reasons. Each response will state whether responsive material is being withheld on the basis of each objection. Any objection to part of a request will identify the objectionable portion and permit production responsive to the remainder. Defendant asserts no blanket objection to all requests.
edits.name: Request-specific objections and withholding statements

edits.text: 2. PRODUCTION. Within 14 days after service of Plaintiff's First Requests for Production, Defendant will produce responsive, nonprivileged documents within its possession, custody, or control, except material withheld under an objection specifically stated in its response to the applicable request. Each response will identify any resulting limitation on production.
edits.name: Fourteen-day production commitment

edits.text: 3. PRIVILEGE LOG. Within 14 days after service of Plaintiff's First Requests for Production, Defendant will serve a privilege log complying with applicable rules and court orders for responsive material withheld on grounds of privilege or other protection. The log will identify the request or requests to which each entry relates and provide the information required to assess the asserted privilege or protection without revealing protected information. For any material Defendant contends is exempt from logging, Defendant will identify within the same period the specific exception claimed, its legal basis, and the material or category of material to which it applies, with sufficient detail to assess the claimed exception.
edits.name: Fourteen-day privilege log and identified exceptions

edits.text: 4. SUPPLEMENTATION. Defendant will supplement these responses and its production as required by applicable rules or court order. This reservation does not extend, toll, or otherwise alter any applicable response, production, privilege-log, or supplementation deadline.
edits.name: No extension through supplementation
